name: Block Buster VR
summary:
🧱 Block Buster VR is a thrilling twist on the timeless Tetris formula—built from the ground up for virtual reality. In this fast-paced, endlessly replayable experience, block-shaped patterns slide down a massive wall in front of you. Each pattern contains a mix of filled and empty spaces, and your job is to aim and shoot blocks into the gaps to complete the shape.
